Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment uses a custom immuno-purification (TDiP) which is a form of AP-MS. While the search parameters include PTMs like GlyGly (ubiquitin) and acetyl, these were used for mapping the interactome/PTMs of the purified aggregates rather than a dedicated PTM-enrichment workflow (like diGly antibody enrichment). Therefore, mod_ap_ms is the primary routing modifier.

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The proteomics analysis specifically targeted TDiP-isolated TDP-43 aggregates derived from HEK293A cells. Although human brain tissue and mouse microglia were used in other parts of the study (e.g., immunoblotting and phagocytosis assays), the LC-MS/MS data described in the proteomics section and PRIDE metadata are associated with the HEK293A-derived purified complexes.
